task.title: How to create and manage custom roles for specific console services
task.shortdesc: A guided wizard leads you through the steps for adding a role. The following steps describe how to use the Create role wizard.

ul.li: You are logged in to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud ConsoleRed Hat Hybrid Cloud Console as a user who has Organization Administrator permission. You cannot log in to the Hybrid Cloud Console with your email address unless your email address is the same as your Red Hat login. For more information, see .
If you are not an Organization Administrator, you must be a member of a group that has the User Access administrator role assigned to it.

prereq.p: The Default access group contains a subset of all predefined roles. For a list of all predefined roles provided by Red Hat, see section Predefined User Access roles.
prereq.note: You cannot modify a predefined role.

step.cmd: Navigate to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console > Settings > Identity & Access Management > User Access > RolesRed Hat Hybrid Cloud Console > Settings > Identity & Access Management > User Access > Roles. The Roles window appears.
Click the Create role button. This starts the Create role wizard.
At this point in the wizard, you can create a role from scratch or copy an existing role.
